name: SHOPRITE HOLDINGS LIMITED
source: Shoprite Holdings Limited annual financial statements for the 52 weeks ended 28 June 2026, consolidated statement of comprehensive income (https://senspdf.jse.co.za/documents/2026/jse/isse/SHP/afs2026.pdf and https://www.shopriteholdings.co.za/docs/ye2026-sep2026.pdf), figures printed in R million and stored in absolute ZAR. Revenue is the sale of merchandise line (270 775; restated FY2025 252 701) because that is the line Cost of Sales (204 328; 191 259) and Gross Profit (66 447; 61 442) are struck against; the statement's other revenue lines (alternative revenue 3 792, interest revenue 183) sit inside Operating Expenses net. Operating Profit (EBIT) is the group's trading profit (16 162; 14 910). Net Finance Costs is trading profit less the printed profit before income tax (5 192; 4 560). Net Profit is profit from continuing operations (8 084; 7 564); EPS is basic earnings per share from continuing operations (1 498.9 cents; 1 398.4 cents) stored in rand per share. A duplicated period column labelled FY2026 (52wk) was removed: it repeated the FY2026 revenue and net profit and carried the FY2026 EPS alone, so it doubled the newest year in the panel. Read 2026-10-19.
